taskStatement:

taskStatementNotes: Message 0 mixes the bug report with PR process. Dropped the bullets about opening the PR, addressing comments and babysitting. Dropped message 1 (keep the fork's agent docs out of the upstream PR; this does not apply to a replay from an upstream base) and message 2 (fix a failed CI check, sync the fork). Dropped message 3 ('What do you mean by "story removed"? Don't we need to update and fix the story?'). It does carry a requirement (keep the Storybook story rather than removing it), but it arrived at 13:26Z, after the PR's last commit (13:25Z), and this PR never acted on it; the superseding #102974 did include the story.
whyChosen: A layout bug whose fix spans a shared component (frontend/src/lib CyclotronJobInputs), the hog-functions email templater and the workflows product panel, so it tests whether the fix lands in the shared seam or leaks product-specific patches.
